newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble slips after fluctuations on c. bank support.
newsitem.headline: Rouble slips after fluctuations on c. bank support.

text.p: The rouble slipped on Friday after heavy fluctuations as large banks channelled funds into government securities, but the central bank sold dollars to support the national currency, dealers said.
rouble/dollar Feb 7 midday Feb 7 early Feb 6 close
"Since yesterday evening we can see large purchase volumes of roubles by major banks due to their anticipation of a shortage," said Toribank dealer Sergei Grigoryev.
Dealers said banks needed roubles to invest into government securities, where yields had risen after the government levied a 15 percent tax on earnings.
They also said banks needed roubles to fulfill monthly reserve requirements to the central bank.
"Roubles are quite expensive," said Stanislav Chernyakov deputy head of conversion operations department at Tokobank.
He said the central bank most likely bought dollars to keep the rouble within its range for today.
He forecast a further rise of the rouble next Tuesday as banks would need to transfer funds for the Wednesday's Treasury bills auctions and said the strain would relax on Wednesday and Thursday.
